DIAGNOSIS READY: Benign Paroxysmal Positional Vertigo (BPPV).

The clinical picture of sudden onset vertigo lasting exactly three minutes with spontaneous resolution is highly characteristic of BPPV. The normal test results help rule out vestibular neuritis, labyrinthitis, and stroke. Have you noticed any hearing loss, tinnitus, or ear fullness during these episodes?
